# Rule 3.2 Do not excessively crowd RP situations or events. Significant leeway may be provided on this rule, but we encourage you to be mindful of it; saturating an RP situation can significantly detract from others' roleplaying experiences. 
[color=lightgray]⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯[/color] 

• This rule especially applies to how players should behave within specific departments. Some examples are listed below: - [color=lightgray]An excessive number of security officers should not show up to resolve a minor dispute between two crew members. Security should attempt to coordinate to prevent this from happening. Outsiders should avoid intervening with security's operations unless they have a good reason. - [color=lightgray]If a single injured person comes into med, only one or two doctors should actually be treating the patient. Outsiders should avoid patients into medical unless they have information about the patient.
